I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the incident channel, which he's a member of. On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note later that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a fuller address for Southgate in that channel or in the shared files he can see, so I told him to ask Priyanka if he needs one.
